productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Take musical brain breaks to help kids move, engage, or relax with fine + gross motor activities and calming songs. Move, engage, relax! This three-card set of Kindermusik songs for brain breaks is the perfect collection for meeting different needed throughout the day. Whether it's high-energy full-body movement to get the wiggles out, fingerplays to boost engagement and strengthen fine motor muscles, or soothing music to prompt relaxation and calm, these cards have everything needed to create meaningful moments that improve focus, attention, and cognitive function. Tracks included: Where Is Thumbkin? The Wheels on the Bus Two Hands This Little Cow Eats Grass The Itsy Bitsy Spider I Can Wiggle Open, Shut Them Two Little Blackbirds On My Foot Ten Eggs 5 Little Speckled Frogs This Little Piggy Peanut Butter and Jelly There's a Spider on the Floor Rock, Paper, Scissors Five Little Peas Baby Bumblebee I Saw a Little Rabbit 1, 2, Tie My Shoe Tommy Thumbs

productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Take musical brain breaks to help kids move, engage, or relax with fine + gross motor activities and calming songs._**

Move, engage, relax! This three-card set of Kindermusik songs for brain breaks is the perfect collection for meeting different needed throughout the day. Whether it's high-energy full-body movement to get the wiggles out, fingerplays to boost engagement and strengthen fine motor muscles, or soothing music to prompt relaxation and calm, these cards have everything needed to create meaningful moments that improve focus, attention, and cognitive function.

Tracks included:

*   Where Is Thumbkin?

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.
